purpose: Isolated native Beads semantics and small Team-sync command-count probe for call-minimization work.

environment.source_tree_note: The Team-sync run loaded the current source extension from a shared working tree with concurrent uncommitted changes. The trace is command-count evidence, not a release benchmark.

writes: bd --sandbox dep add probe-related probe-open --type blocks

semantic_results.show_mixed_existing_missing: exit 0; returns found records in input order and writes the missing ID to stderr
semantic_results.show_only_missing: exit 1; stdout is a JSON error object, not an array
semantic_results.show_closed: exit 0; includes closed records without an --all flag
semantic_results.show_relation: dependencies contain full target records and dependency_type; reverse details require --include-dependents
semantic_results.show_metadata: nested and numeric metadata values retain JSON types; absent metadata is omitted
semantic_results.list_existing_multi_id: exit 0; returns priority order, not positional input order
semantic_results.list_duplicate_id: exit 0; returns one record for each unique ID
semantic_results.list_closed_default: exit 0; omits closed records unless --all is supplied
semantic_results.list_relation: returns compact dependency edges, not full target records

warm_timing_ms.method: one unreported warm-up, then seven round-robin trials; stdout and stderr discarded

team_sync_fixture.setup: A fresh Herdr Pi agent loaded the explicit rc.5 source extension in an isolated authority. It initialized that authority, created one Team and three unassigned fixture Tasks, then requested two snapshot views. No Worker was created.

snapshot_command_chain.outer_wall_limit: The manually bracketed values include Pi model/tool response overhead. The trace has no parent operation correlation, so do not treat them as a benchmark of Team-sync latency.

conclusions: Native multi-ID show minimizes process invocations but is not set semantics: it preserves order and duplicates, accepts closed Tasks, and has a different missing-ID contract from list.
list is faster in this three-Task fixture but changes order, duplicate, missing, closed, and relation semantics. It cannot replace detailed hydration.
The three-Task Team-sync path used exactly one list and one multi-ID show per snapshot. No per-Task show appears in its payload-free trace.
Use the native trace durations only as a small local diagnostic. A representative latency claim needs the planned parent-correlated outer trace and controlled workload.
The isolated authority and both temporary Herdr workspaces were removed after evidence collection.
